prompt:
Hey — our AI assistant just finished a long working session on the Meridian pipeline fix and a few other things. I've got the session transcript saved in the memory/ folder. I need you to properly close out that session and get the workspace organized before the next person picks this up Monday.

Specifically:
1. The workspace seems to have a session management skill in skills/buffer/SKILL.md. Read it and set up whatever companion tooling it says to install if it's not already there.
2. Archive the session state properly so the next person can pick up instantly — there should be a file called HANDOFF.md in the workspace root.
3. The MEMORY.md and AGENTS.md files are bloated and messy. Get them cleaned up and within whatever limits the skill documentation specifies — the AGENTS.md in particular has some structural issues that need fixing.

Don't just stub out empty files — the HANDOFF.md should actually reflect what happened in the session, and the memory files should be properly trimmed without losing the important stuff.
